description: Return one funnel's conversion broken down by referrer, by funnelId from list_funnels. Paginated over referrers. Referrers with a single visitor are omitted, so totals can be lower than get_funnel_analytics.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Use with to; alternative to preset.

limit.description: Maximum items to return, 1-100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Use with from; alternative to preset.

name: get_funnel_analytics_by_referrer
title: Get funnel analytics by referrer
